seoDescription: Book a fit conversation or a Design Jumpstart. Interior design that changes how you rest, gather, and think.
hook: Your space is already deciding how you live. Most people decorate around that. Few redesign it to change how they rest, gather, and think.

projectOffer.title: Full project
projectOffer.body: A redesign of how a home or room operates, from layout and material to guest flow and daily rituals.
projectOffer.note: I take on a few residences a year, in Vienna and remote. Projects often run 1-3 months.

jumpstartOffer.title: Design Jumpstart
jumpstartOffer.body: One hour session. Get a clear point of view on the change that would matter most, and your next step.

quote.text: My daughter started calling her room the room from the fairy tale.
